- H46:L46 (25th percentile) and H47:L47 (75th percentile) returned `#NAME?`.
- This error typically occurs when Excel (or the test environment's evaluator) does not recognize a function name. 
- The task requested `PERCENTILE` or `PERCENTILE.INC`. If `PERCENTILE.INC` was used, it might not be supported by the evaluator, or there may be a typo in the formula string.
- Other statistics (MIN, MAX, MEDIAN, AVERAGE) and the lookup/net headroom formulas appear to have worked or at least didn't produce `#NAME?` errors in the assertion trace.

Check the exact function names being written to rows 46 and 47.
